name: SciMiner
description: Web-based literature mining tool for gene/protein extraction and functional enrichment analysis.

details.longDescription: SciMiner is a web-based literature mining and functional analysis tool that automatically identifies genes and proteins mentioned in biomedical text. It processes PubMed abstracts or user-supplied text to extract gene/protein mentions using dictionary-based and rule-based NLP approaches, then performs functional enrichment analysis (Gene Ontology, KEGG pathways) on the extracted targets.
features: Automated gene/protein extraction from PubMed abstracts

name: PubChemSR
description: Stand-alone program for data retrieval from NCBI PubChem databases.

details.longDescription: PubChemSR (PubChem Structure-activity Relationship) is a Java-based stand-alone application for retrieving and analyzing chemical compound data from NCBI PubChem databases. It supports batch queries, bioassay data retrieval, and structure-activity analysis for pharmacological research.
features: Export to CSV and SDF formats

name: DNMKB2
description: Repository and analysis portal for diabetic neuropathy transcriptomics data with 140 DEG sets.

details.longDescription: DNMKB2 (Diabetic Neuropathy Molecular Knowledge Base v2) is a comprehensive repository and analysis portal for diabetic peripheral neuropathy transcriptomics data. It integrates 140 differentially expressed gene (DEG) sets from multiple DPN studies, enabling cross-study comparison, meta-analysis, and pathway enrichment across mouse and human models.

name: VennDetail
description: Bioconductor R package for Venn-Pie plots and subset extraction supporting up to 8 sets.

details.longDescription: VennDetail is a Bioconductor R package that provides comprehensive Venn diagram analysis with Pie chart overlays. Unlike traditional Venn diagrams limited to 3-4 sets, VennDetail supports up to 8 sets and provides detailed subset extraction, making it ideal for comparing gene lists from multiple omics experiments.
features: Support for up to 8 comparison sets

name: richR
description: Functional enrichment and visualization R package for comprehensive pathway analysis.

details.longDescription: richR is a comprehensive R package for functional enrichment analysis supporting GO, KEGG, Reactome, and custom gene sets. It provides advanced visualization including dot plots, bar plots, network plots, and enrichment maps, with built-in support for multiple species and gene ID conversion.
features: Multiple visualization types (dot, bar, network, enrichment map)

name: Tox21 Enricher
description: Online enrichment tool for Tox21 chemical screening data with R version available.

details.longDescription: Tox21 Enricher is an online tool for performing enrichment analysis on Tox21 chemical screening data from the NIH Tox21 program. It allows researchers to identify overrepresented biological pathways and toxicity endpoints among sets of chemical compounds, supporting both web-based and R package interfaces.
features: Enrichment analysis for Tox21 chemical data

name: richStudio
description: R Shiny application for interactive enrichment and clustering analyses.

details.longDescription: richStudio is an interactive R Shiny web application that provides a GUI for performing enrichment analysis and hierarchical clustering without writing code. It wraps richR and richCluster functionality in an accessible web interface for researchers with limited programming experience.

name: richCluster
description: C++-based hierarchical clustering algorithm wrapped in R for high-performance cluster analysis.

details.longDescription: richCluster is an R package with a C++ backend that provides high-performance hierarchical clustering for large-scale biological data. It implements optimized algorithms for gene expression clustering, pathway grouping, and enrichment result organization, significantly outperforming pure R implementations.

name: scGEN
description: Gene-aware embedding network for single-cell RNA-seq clustering using deep learning.

details.longDescription: scGEN (single-cell Gene-aware Embedding Network) is a deep learning framework for single-cell RNA-seq analysis. It uses gene-aware neural network architectures to learn biologically meaningful cell embeddings, enabling improved cell type clustering, trajectory inference, and batch effect correction compared to traditional dimensionality reduction methods.

name: DPNKB
description: Comprehensive knowledgebase integrating genomic, transcriptomic, and clinical data for diabetic peripheral neuropathy research.

details.longDescription: DPNKB (Diabetic Peripheral Neuropathy Knowledge Base) is a comprehensive web-based knowledgebase that integrates genomic, transcriptomic, and clinical data for the study of diabetic peripheral neuropathy (DPN). It serves as an exploration and analysis platform for DPN gene expression data, enabling researchers to query and analyze differentially expressed genes across multiple DPN studies and models.

name: VIOLIN
description: Vaccine Investigation and Online Information Network — a comprehensive vaccine knowledgebase integrating AI-driven literature analysis with ontology annotation.

details.longDescription: VIOLIN (Vaccine Investigation and Online Information Network) is a comprehensive web-based vaccine knowledgebase that integrates AI-driven literature analysis with ontology-based data annotation. VIOLIN 2.0 includes curated data on vaccine components, host responses, and protection mechanisms across hundreds of licensed and experimental vaccines, supported by the Vaccine Ontology (VO) for standardized representation.
features: Host response and protection mechanism data

name: Ignet
description: Interactive gene interaction network visualization and analysis system for ontology-based literature-mined networks.

details.longDescription: Ignet is an interactive web-based system for visualizing and analyzing gene-gene interaction networks derived from ontology-based literature mining. It displays networks extracted by SciMiner and other NLP tools, allowing researchers to explore gene relationships, identify hub genes, and discover novel biological connections in the published literature.
